reference_design.interpretation: Global optimum of the worst material energy bound under the exact stated ordering; not a guarantee of minimum PCG iterations or runtime.
reference_design.floating_point_verification: Float64 tolerance tests, not interval-arithmetic certificates.
reference_design.hg_argument: scale(C)=trace(W*C), W=(t*t.T+7*diag(1,1,1,2,2,2))/60 positive definite; material Loewner bounds therefore also bound stabilization scale ratios.

protocol: FI eight-point integration; six unit engineering strains; FP64 physics/FP32 FFT; true residual <=1e-8; same-grid full warmup; fresh process; geometry/JIT/warmup/I/O excluded; setup, loading, solve, certification and stress recovery included.
